policy: Lead agent owns exclusive write access to orchestrator source. Subagents are explicitly allowed to write only the files listed below. Lead agent audits and merges subagent patches before commit.

subagent_data_metric_auditor.role: Audit data contracts and metric protocols
subagent_data_metric_auditor.deliverable_format: Markdown audit report returned to Lead agent via Task output

subagent_runtime_optimizer.deliverable_format: Markdown recommendation report returned to Lead agent

subagent_evidence_verifier.deliverable_format: JSON verification report returned to Lead agent

subagent_repo_scout.role: Discover candidate repositories for a paper
subagent_repo_scout.deliverable_format: CSV candidate list + Markdown summary returned to Lead agent

subagent_hardware_fit_auditor.role: Match repository requirements to local hardware

subagent_explore.deliverable_format: Verbatim answer returned to Lead agent

subagent_general_purpose.role: General-purpose agent for any task the Lead cannot do directly
subagent_general_purpose.deliverable_format: Free-form; Lead agent parses and decides what to keep

subagent_bugbot.deliverable_format: Bugbot review report returned to Lead agent

subagent_security_review.deliverable_format: Security review report returned to Lead agent

lock_rules: Lead agent holds exclusive write lock on scripts/orchestrator/**
Subagents do NOT modify scripts/orchestrator/** — they propose patches via reports
artifacts/runs/<run_id>/checkpoints/** is exclusively EvidenceManager-managed (no agent writes)

handoff_protocol.subagent_to_lead: Subagent output returned directly via Task tool response
handoff_protocol.lead_to_subagent: Lead agent constructs Task tool call with detailed prompt
handoff_protocol.lead_to_user: Lead posts structured STATUS_REPORT.md or DECISION_PROPOSAL.md in main conversation
handoff_protocol.user_to_lead: USER_DECISIONS.md appended decisions, read on next cycle
handoff_protocol.parallel_execution: Lead can invoke multiple Task calls in single message for parallel subagent execution
